name: Melvins
hook: A slow, heavy band from a small Washington logging town whose drummer played on Nirvana's first recordings.
blurb: The Melvins formed in Montesano, Washington, in 1983, near Aberdeen, where Kurt Cobain grew up: Buzz Osborne, Matt Lukin and Mike Dillard, with Osborne and drummer Dale Crover the members who have stayed since 1984. They played very slow, very heavy riffs, and they are credited as pioneers of sludge metal and a key influence on the sound people later called grunge. Crover played drums on Nirvana's first demo on 23 January 1988, and those takes of 'Floyd the Barber', 'Paper Cuts' and 'Downer' were remixed for Nirvana's first album, 'Bleach'. Osborne later introduced Cobain and Krist Novoselic to their drummer Dave Grohl.

signatureTracks.title: Eye Flys
signatureTracks.whyThisOne: The opening track of their first album, 'Gluey Porch Treatments': as slow and heavy as punk-era rock got.
